gt_provenance.details: Same LLM-judge proxy pipeline as main experiment: GPT-5.4-generated gold answers, GPT-5.4 accuracy judge, automated behaviour annotation via LLM classifier. No human-annotation or dataset GT. Identical provenance warning as main experiment Phase 2 audit — not a new failure, inherited by design.

score_normalization.details: n_distinct_operating_points is a count. accuracy and coherence_rate are proportions out of n=60 tasks. No normalization issues — consistent with main experiment.

result_existence.details: All 8 controllers completed with results_summary.json confirmed at 8/8 entries. Steering controllers: coherence_rate in [0.0, 0.40], behaviour_rate=0.0 for all (consistent with sigma_proj=886 finding from M1). Prompt controllers: coherence_rate=1.0, behaviour_rate in [0.133, 0.35]. TI controllers: coherence_rate=1.0, behaviour_rate in [0.633, 0.667]. Results are internally consistent and plausible.

dead_code.details: Matched-rate pairing algorithm (pair controllers with rate diff <=2pts) not exercised per-task for variant audit. Same WARN as Phase 2 — algorithm exists in source but per-task verification requires per-task result files not checked here. n_distinct computation verified independently from summary-level data.

scope.details: Variant scope: expressing_uncertainty only, n=60 tasks, same benchmark subset as main experiment. Documented in PLAN.md. No scope overreach. sigma_proj=886 finding is variant-specific and scientifically meaningful — not a scope violation.

sigma_proj_finding.details: sigma_proj=886 for Qwen-14B (vs 10.52 for Llama-8B, 84x larger). This is a meaningful architectural finding: the sigma_proj-scaled CAA formula produces coefficients ~84x larger on Qwen-14B, causing near-total output incoherence. The evaluation correctly captures this — coherence_rate collapses for all steering controllers. Not an audit failure.

model_swap_fidelity.details: M1 re-run on Qwen-14B: 200 chains, 48 layers, L*=45 selected. M4 re-run with 8 controllers x 60 tasks. Same auxiliary corpus, same benchmark tasks, same evaluation pipeline. Model swap executed faithfully.
